body:
Proves convergence of the full component Euler product for every positive integer N. For primitive components its limit has norm at most the ordinary singular series. The limit is not yet identified with genSing.

Supplies Decomp247a with two strictly smaller OPEN leaves and an assembly with the exact sealed euler_gen_eq statement. The original DecompJ249 file is unchanged. The OPEN work is the fixed data coefficient majorant and the finite smooth product expansion.

Adds 33 proved helper theorems with clean axioms. These include explicit unramified prime values, parity vanishing, coefficient tail bounds, totient ratios and a counterexample to a norm only convergence inference. The coefficient tail and summability comparison helpers are proved implications from the explicit majorant. That majorant remains OPEN. No paper error is claimed.

Validation rebuilt all 67 original active modules, all five archive source path targets and all eight new modules. The independent audit ran 38 declaration reports. It records 34 clean reports, including one definition, and four OPEN or dependent reports. All source review rows are MATCH. Concrete character, convergence and summability instances pass. The sorry delta is plus two new LEAF sorries. No existing statement or proof is weakened.

The gate single line parser reports only one warning because three axiom lists wrap across lines. The independent multiline audit and the statement ledger correctly label all four pending declarations.

```text
RESULT PASS  CODEX-task247  folder BhowmikGrimmelt2026  base 2d0b6f41f
WARN 1 theorems use other axioms, label them CONDITIONAL or sorry: 'LeanLab.BhowmikGrimmelt2026.euler_gen_eq_supply247' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
SEAL PASS
```

Resolved preflight seal warning:

```text
WARN uncommitted .lean changes are not checked; commit them first
```

The final seal checked the committed source and printed SEAL PASS. The failed intermediate compiler and probe outputs remain in the committed cumulative log. No branch FAIL remains.

AI wrote the Lean code. Goldbach is open.
